title: chuanyue_yiri ep01 · 音频预览
tagline: 出视频前的整集听感：本地 VoxCPM2 按人物声样模拟对白，无画面、无配乐、无音效；每镜时长与台词起点就是之后出视频的目标。

chapters.title: s1 · 庞贝海门一带：海边的黑沙滩与陡坡、海门的拱顶门洞、门内第一条石板街
s2 · 城里的一条玄武岩石板街：横排的垫脚石，街角的牛头石槽喷泉
s3 · 一间敞开门脸的面包房：门脸上的石台、后面的石磨与砖炉，门外的街
s4 · 一条窄街，一间洗衣坊的门口与门厅，后面是踩洗石槽的院子；正午的十字路口
s8 · 伊西斯神庙院墙外的街；广场浴场女区：外门门厅、更衣温水厅、热水室；浴场门外的街
s5 · 熟食铺前的东西向石板街（前面一个十字街口，往右是一条横街）；街角熟食铺：L 形彩色大理石碎片柜台，嵌着陶罐
s6 · 城南斯塔比亚门边的大车店门口、院子与楼下大堂
s7 · 大车店二楼的小客房；夜里的庞贝屋顶

cues.text: Oh my god. Okay… it worked. It actually worked. That's — that's Pompeii up there. Like, the real one.Wait, wait — I gotta do this right.

Good morning from Pompeii! It's May, 75 AD — which is so weird to say out loud. Okay, two things today: I need somewhere to sleep before it gets dark, and I need to try garum — it's this fish sauce everyone here is obsessed with. And my budget for all of that is… this. Yeah. That's all I've got.
Come here — see those little guys? Those are gonna be garum. That's what they make it out of.
Oh — look at all these cracks. They're all patched up. There was this huge earthquake here, like, twelve years ago — and they're still fixing it.
Okay, made it. So there's no sewer here — the street is basically the drain. That's what these big stepping stones are for. 'Cause you do not wanna walk through… whatever's in there.
Yeah… I don't think she's a fan of the pants.
Oh, it's pre-cut! Look at that — it just snaps right off. So the Romans basically had sliced bread? That's so smart.
Mm — mm. Okay, that's really dense. Like, kind of smoky? It's so good, though.
Garum? Where can I get garum? Like, around here?
Garum? Non hic. Hac recta platea… ito ad dextram!
I have no idea what "dextram" means. But he pointed that way, so I'm just gonna go left.
Okay, so I'm still going left, and garum's gotta be down here somewhere.

So I just got kicked out of a Roman laundromat. And get this — they wash clothes in pee here. Like, actual pee. And the emperor taxes it. His son was like, "Dad, that's disgusting," so he just holds a coin up to his son's nose and goes, "Does this smell?"
…Nope. Nothing. Just, like, metal. Okay, honestly — he kind of has a point.
Okay, so… everything's closed. I think it's, like, nap time or something. And I have no idea where I am. And — yep. Still smell like pee. Great.
Hear that? That's gotta be the temple of Isis. I read they do their afternoon thing around two. So it's, like, two o'clock — perfect time for the baths.
Okay, wait — that was it? One tiny coin? That's, like, nothing.
Oh my god, it is so hot in here. Okay. I'm officially melting.
Okay, so there's no soap. You just rub oil all over yourself and then scrape it off with this thing — and look, it actually works! Gross. Kind of love it, though.
I could stay here all day.
Dies nihil est. Dum versas te, nox fit.
I have no idea what she just said, but I'm pretty sure it was "get moving."
Okay, I'm clean. Ish. And I am starving — which, good news, people eat dinner here at, like, three-thirty. So it's basically dinner time. And I've been saving my bread for garum.
Wait. "Dextram" means right? …Oh my god. I've been going the wrong way all day.
Okay, so… one's the cheap stuff, and two's the good stuff? Is that — right?
Oh my god, the OK sign works! She knows the OK sign!
Oh — she's putting water in it. Yeah, apparently everyone waters down their wine here. Drinking it straight is, like, a barbarian thing.
Um — do you have any garum? For my bread?
Mm. Okay, it's really salty, and kind of… funky? Oh wait — no, that's actually good. It really is just fish sauce! My grandma puts fish sauce on literally everything. She would love this.
Huh. Watery… but not bad. Okay. Now I just need to find a bed.
Okay, the sun's going down, and I still don't have anywhere to sleep. And this is all the money I have left. Hope that's enough for a bed.
Oh, this is basically a truck stop.
Oh, and we've got air conditioning.
So it's literally a bag of straw on some ropes. And this blanket is super itchy. Rustic, I guess.
It's fine, though. It's a bed. And I'm honestly still thinking about that garum. I don't have any money left, but — yeah, I'd do it again.

People write on, like, every wall here. And there's this famous one — I swear it was in my history textbook — from an inn just like this. It says, "Vibius Restitutus slept here alone, and missed his Urbana." That's kind of sweet.
Okay. I'm gonna try to sleep. I honestly don't know where I'll wake up tomorrow… but, uh — goodnight from Pompeii.

notes.title: 怎么用
items: 点进度条或下面的卡片跳到那一镜；播放时大图换成当前镜头的故事板，下方显示正在说的台词。
全片 15:13.0，61 镜；每镜时长 = 起势 + 台词 + 句间停顿 + 收尾，取整秒、不少于 4 秒。
配音只是听感预览（AI 合成），不进成片；改台词或时长后重跑 `python tools/audio_preview.py build` 即更新。
